title: Implement bufferbloat TX-queue oracle family and consume no_silent_drops + tx_queue_*.json
description: test/vectors/no_silent_drops.json, tx_queue_bounded.json, tx_queue_expiry.json, tx_queue_priority.json, tx_queue_implementation.json (appendix-bufferbloat.md) unconsumed. Only a Zephyr C tx_queue header exists; no python/rust oracle implementation. Implement the TX-queue semantics (constants already pinned by vectors: constants field present) and wire all five files.
close_reason: TX-queue oracle family implemented and consumed: lichen/timing/tx_queue.py (Priority IntEnum with ACK alias of ROUTING, per-class default deadlines, TxQueueEntry absolute deadlines, TxQueue with B.3.1 push contract expire->capacity->preempt/reject, oldest-among-lowest eviction, reserve=peek+in-flight so len unchanged, complete(True) transmits+latency stats / complete(False) signals without requeue, expire_stale on all accessors, QueueFullError backpressure, no-silent-drops reservation signaling on every drop path). 47 pytest cases in tests/timing/test_tx_queue_vectors.py cover all vectors from tx_queue_implementation/bounded/expiry/priority + TxQueue component vectors of no_silent_drops. Cross-file contradiction between priority file (reserve keeps length) and expiry requeue vector resolved by peek+mark model which satisfies both byte-for-byte. Remaining no_silent_drops component vectors (ForwardingBuffer/ICMPv6/Router) split to child bead z3k8. Full timing suite 769 passed; ruff/format clean.
